excerpt: Identified mid-rapidity particle spectra of $\pi^{\pm}$, $K^{\pm}$, and $p(\bar{p})$ from 200 GeV p+p and d+Au collisions are reported. This data were taken in 2003 run from the Solenoidal Tracker at RHIC (STAR) experiment. A time-of-flight detector based on multi-gap resistive plate chamber (MRPC)
title: Thesis: Pion, Kaon, Proton and Antiproton Spectra in d+Au and p+p Collisions at $\sqrt{s_{NN}}$= 200GeV at the Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider
